name: zopt_get_game_difficulty_mode
description: zOpt::GetGameDifficultyMode returns the current game difficulty option value through the stored option pointer.
known_limits: Tier S byte evidence is covered by python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x407f20.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x407f20 validates loading g_zOpt_GameDifficultyOption and returning the pointed-to integer value with no callees.
The native zOpt accessor smoke writes difficulty through zOpt::SetGameDifficultyMode and verifies zOpt::GetGameDifficultyMode returns the same stored value.
